## FineFit - Luxury Bespoke Tailoring Website

This is a Next.js TypeScript project for FineFit, a luxury bespoke tailoring brand (formerly Chandra Textiles).

### Tech Stack
- Next.js 14+ with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Modern, elegant design inspired by Huntsman Savile Row

### Design Guidelines
- Sophisticated, luxury aesthetic
- Clean typography with serif fonts for elegance
- Large hero images
- Minimalist navigation
- Focus on craftsmanship and tradition

### Project Structure
- `/app` - Next.js App Router pages
- `/components` - Reusable React components
- `/public` - Static assets and images
- `/styles` - Global styles and Tailwind config
